lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A vertical alignment of three large, high-intensity circular spots is located immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit. To the posterior of this triad, spots are distributed in approximately four horizontal rows, with intensity decreasing toward the ventral surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, forming a grid-like pattern where the largest blobs serve as primary nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
